title: Which layer came first?
hook: A stack keeps a record of its sequence.

doesNotKnow: How relative order follows from undisturbed layering.

misconception: The uppermost undisturbed sediment layer must be oldest.
objective: Infer relative order for a specified undisturbed stack.

claims.text: In an undisturbed stack deposited in sequence, each layer is younger than the layer it covers; later overturning or disturbance limits this inference.
claims.source: Source lead for independent verification: US Geological Survey, National Geologic Map Database, https://www.usgs.gov/programs/national-geologic-map-database; the specific supporting text has not been checked.

claims.text: The stage is a schematic model, with stated example values or sample counts; it is not a reconstruction of an observed field site.
Recall: An undisturbed stack is deposited X, then Y, then Z. Which is younger than X? In the stipulated order, Y was deposited after X.
claims.source: Relative order or arithmetic under the explicitly stated example conditions.

recall.question: An undisturbed stack is deposited X, then Y, then Z. Which is younger than X?
recall.why: In the stipulated order, Y was deposited after X.
